packageRules.description: Patch updates of the Python image and the pip packages (flask 3.1.3 → 3.1.4): Renovate merges once the end-to-end test is green; the merge makes an automatic patch release
Minor/major (Python 3.14 → 3.15, flask 3.1 → 3.2 or 4.0): PR only, merged by hand after a look
One PR for werkzeug + flask, they release together
GitHub Actions minor/patch: merged once CI is green, no release (the image doesn't change)
